MediaPipe Vision native dependencies — conservative upstream notice set.
The JNI binary is the unchanged official tasks-vision 0.10.32 Maven artifact.
Upstream source: https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe/tree/8317ba78778738ba90a521e7e4580a2ba0129c81
TensorFlow source used by that upstream contract:
https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow/tree/fad6b3cf5a7d51a437bd01ee929853bc8554b618
Their WORKSPACE and third_party workspace files record dependency archive commits/checksums.
All upstream license/notice texts collected from those resolved native source dependencies
are included below. No build-tool/JDK/NDK/Python license is represented as app code.

Apache-2.0: Abseil, FlatBuffers, gemmlowp, ruy, TensorFlow (also its bundled Caffe BSD notice).
BSD: glog, protobuf, cpuinfo, farmhash, pthreadpool, XNNPACK.
MIT: FP16, FXdiv. zlib: zlib license. FFT2D: Takuya Ooura's retained permissive notice.
Eigen: MPL-2.0, with the included Apache/BSD/MINPACK-compatible portions (see COPYING.README).
These third-party terms do not place AI Photographer itself under an open-source license.
The upstream WORKSPACE also declares OpenCV 3.4.11 (BSD-3-Clause) and Android OpenCV
4.12.0 (Apache-2.0). Both upstream license texts are retained conservatively; this is
not a claim that both versions are linked in the published JNI artifact.
https://github.com/opencv/opencv/tree/3.4.11
https://github.com/opencv/opencv/tree/4.12.0

Eigen source-code availability for recipients of the compiled MPL-covered portion:
https://gitlab.com/libeigen/eigen/-/archive/4c38131a16803130b66266a912029504f2cf23cd/eigen-4c38131a16803130b66266a912029504f2cf23cd.tar.gz
The eigen_archive alias resolves to the same commit, also pinned by TensorFlow's third_party/xla/third_party/eigen3/workspace.bzl:
https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow/blob/fad6b3cf5a7d51a437bd01ee929853bc8554b618/third_party/xla/third_party/eigen3/workspace.bzl
No Eigen source modification is made by AI Photographer. MPL applies to its covered files;
the application is a larger work. License text and source availability are retained offline.

Upstream notice-collection provenance:
https://github.com/binhvugia1997-ui/app-ch-p-nh/actions/runs/37481571058
This is conservative attribution, not a claim that every listed upstream target executes at runtime.
